required.what: VREF+: when VDDA < 2 V must equal VDDA; when VDDA >= 2 V must be between 2 V and VDDA (may be grounded if analog peripherals using VREF+ are inactive)
VDDIO2 must not be applied without valid VDD
Decoupling: VDD/VDDA 100 nF + 4.7 uF; VDDIO2 100 nF + 4.7 uF; VREF+ 100 nF + 1 uF (1 uF only when VREFBUF used), placed as close as possible to the pins
All main power pins (VDD/VDDA, VDDIO2, VBAT) and grounds must always be connected to supplies in the permitted range
Inputs above VDD+0.3 V (FT pins, operating) require the internal pull-up/pull-down disabled; operating VIN max Min(VDD+3.6, 5.5) V for FT, VDD+0.3 V for RST, VDDA+0.3 V for TT_xx, 5.0 V for FT_c
